item.text: The key boundary is clear: edits can wait 120 ms, but close/open must flush an accepted edit before returning, and submit must flush before archiving. Store notifications run inline and can navigate, so I’m also preserving visit ownership during those flushes.

The change is in place. A deterministic timer check passed for coalesced writes, later bursts, close/open flushing, submit flushing, and navigation triggered from a save callback. I’m reviewing the final diff and recording the verification result.

item.text:
The draft editor now uses the existing trailing task to save only the latest text after 120 ms of quiet. Later editing bursts continue to save. Close and open flush pending edits before returning, and submit flushes before capturing its receipt. Save callbacks that navigate cannot restore an older editor visit or show its submission notice.

Deterministic timer checks and JavaScript syntax checks passed. The search preview was unchanged.
